description: Store JSON, text or a small file (up to 10 MB) as a PUBLIC item for 1 to 7 days, free, no payment or key needed. Anyone with the returned public link can open it (100 opens included), so never put secrets here. Give exactly one of content, content_base64 or file_path. Returns id, secret, expiry and links.public.

content_type.description: MIME type. Detected from the content when omitted.

file_path.description: Path of a local file to upload.

label.description: A label to recognise the item later.

ttl_days.description: Days to keep the item (default 7, at most 7).

name: store_public
